flow_overview: A park-specific amusement park ticketing and add-on purchase flow that localizes offers by park, lets users browse and configure add-ons, and reviews selections in a cart before checkout.
capability_summary: Checkout entry with consent and accessibility support

requirements.text: The system shall provide visible feedback when the selected quantity changes so the pending purchase configuration remains clear.
requirements.rationale: The quantity change is reflected in the pending purchase configuration before cart addition.

claims.claim: The system provides feedback when the selected quantity changes.
claims.claim_text: The system provides feedback when the selected quantity changes.

claims.claim: The pending purchase configuration remains clear after the selected quantity changes.
claims.claim_text: The pending purchase configuration remains clear after the selected quantity changes.

requirements.evidence_note: Step 8 shows the pending configuration with quantity 1. Step 9 shows the same configuration with quantity 2.

requirements.text: The system shall preserve a user-selected digital or mobile ticket fulfillment choice across cart review and the transition into checkout unless the user explicitly changes it.
requirements.rationale: The screenshots do not establish the precondition or the cross-step preservation behavior required by the requirement.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall support selection of a digital or mobile ticket fulfillment option as part of the purchase flow.

claims.claim: A digital or mobile ticket fulfillment choice is selected by the user.
claims.claim_text: A digital or mobile ticket fulfillment choice is selected by the user.

claims.claim: The selected fulfillment choice is preserved across cart review and checkout transition unless changed by the user.
claims.claim_text: The selected fulfillment choice is preserved across cart review and checkout transition unless changed by the user.

requirements.evidence_note: No explicit digital or mobile fulfillment choice is shown, and the transition into checkout is not included.

requirements.text: The system shall clearly indicate the downstream delivery destination or channel for digital tickets, such as email or mobile wallet, before the user proceeds to payment.
requirements.rationale: The flow does not provide enough evidence to verify or contradict delivery-channel indication before payment.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall support selection of a digital or mobile ticket fulfillment option as part of the purchase flow.

claims.claim: The system indicates the downstream delivery destination or channel for digital tickets before payment.
claims.claim_text: The system indicates the downstream delivery destination or channel for digital tickets before payment.

requirements.evidence_note: The pre-checkout cart is visible, but it does not show an email, mobile wallet, or other digital ticket delivery destination. Later checkout steps are not included.

requirements.text: The system shall enforce any required pass-ownership or eligibility policy for park add-ons and explain that policy in the purchase flow before checkout.
requirements.rationale: The explanatory part is visible, while enforcement of eligibility policy is not verifiable from screenshots alone.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall disclose important product conditions such as eligibility, usage restrictions, or special purchase notes before the user commits to an add-on purchase.

claims.claim: The purchase flow explains pass-ownership or eligibility policy for park add-ons.
claims.claim_text: The purchase flow explains pass-ownership or eligibility policy for park add-ons.

claims.claim: The system enforces required pass-ownership or eligibility policy before checkout.
claims.claim_text: The system enforces required pass-ownership or eligibility policy before checkout.

requirements.evidence_note: Steps 6 and 8 disclose membership availability and ride restrictions, but no policy enforcement behavior is demonstrated.

requirements.text: The system shall disclose all monetary components that can affect the final pre-checkout charge for the selected park purchase, including any park-specific surcharges or fulfillment-related fees.
requirements.rationale: The visible monetary summary is supported, while the universal completeness claim is not settled by the screenshots.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall present an itemized pre-checkout order summary including subtotal, fees, tax, and total.

claims.claim: The pre-checkout charge disclosure includes monetary components for the selected park purchase.
claims.claim_text: The pre-checkout charge disclosure includes monetary components for the selected park purchase.

claims.claim: The disclosed monetary components cover all park-specific surcharges and fulfillment-related fees that can affect the final pre-checkout charge.
claims.claim_text: The disclosed monetary components cover all park-specific surcharges and fulfillment-related fees that can affect the final pre-checkout charge.

requirements.evidence_note: Step 10 shows subtotal, processing fee, tax, and total, but cannot prove completeness for all possible park-specific surcharges or fulfillment-related fees.

requirements.text: The system shall provide a dedicated pre-checkout review step where the user can confirm or change the selected ticket fulfillment method before continuing to payment.
requirements.rationale: The shown pre-checkout review step visibly lacks the required fulfillment-method confirmation or change mechanism.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall allow cart contents to be reviewed and modified before proceeding to checkout.

claims.claim: The system provides a dedicated pre-checkout review step before payment.
claims.claim_text: The system provides a dedicated pre-checkout review step before payment.

claims.claim: The pre-checkout review step lets the user confirm or change the selected ticket fulfillment method before payment.
claims.claim_text: The pre-checkout review step lets the user confirm or change the selected ticket fulfillment method before payment.

requirements.evidence_note: Step 10 shows the relevant pre-checkout cart review, but no ticket fulfillment method confirmation or change control is present in that review step.

requirements.text: The system shall keep the selected park context, configured add-on quantity, and chosen ticket fulfillment method synchronized between add-on configuration, cart line items, and order summary screens.
requirements.rationale: The synchronization requirement is supported for park context and quantity, but missing for ticket fulfillment.
requirements.parent_harvest_text: The system shall preserve the selected park context consistently across discovery, add-on selection, and cart review screens.

claims.claim: The selected park context is synchronized between add-on configuration, cart line items, and order summary states.
claims.claim_text: The selected park context is synchronized between add-on configuration, cart line items, and order summary states.

claims.claim: The configured add-on quantity is synchronized between add-on configuration and cart line items.
claims.claim_text: The configured add-on quantity is synchronized between add-on configuration and cart line items.

claims.claim: The chosen ticket fulfillment method is synchronized between add-on configuration, cart line items, and order summary states.
claims.claim_text: The chosen ticket fulfillment method is synchronized between add-on configuration, cart line items, and order summary states.

requirements.evidence_note: Park context and add-on quantity are carried through configuration and cart review, but no chosen ticket fulfillment method is visible in those states.
